title: Migration overwrites authoritative historical goals
evidence: Synthetic initializer fixture: goalAtTime 20 becomes 5 when a numeric entry and missing goalHistory trigger inference; evidence/synthetic-initialization-and-dst.json. All entries are rewritten, not just numeric legacy records.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Historical completion percentages and goals can change on opening a screen.
proposed_solution: Separate minimal fix: retain explicit goalAtTime; define an evidence-backed policy for genuinely unknown legacy goals. Do not disable migration wholesale.
tests_required: Mixed numeric/object logs; explicit goals; ties; missing/deleted workouts; multiple mounts; before/after backups.

title: Timestamp cleanup removes genuine timestamps and logs journal text
evidence: includes(T18:00:00) accepts genuine timestamps with any fractional seconds; synthetic .123Z becomes a plain string. Console logs first 50 characters of the journal.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Loss of journal time metadata and unnecessary private text in logs.
proposed_solution: Require actual migration provenance; preserve ambiguous timestamps; remove text logging in a separate patch.
tests_required: Genuine 18:00 timestamps, known estimated fixtures, strings, missing timestamps, repeated mount.

title: Malformed stored JSON can be replaced by default state
evidence: safeParseJSON returns fallback without an error marker; the hook subsequently persists that fallback (lines 215–222). Similar autosave patterns occur in hydration, meditation, reminders and dated food loading/saving. Food migration also treats malformed existing food JSON as an empty database.
reproduction: In a disposable context seed workout-tracker-data with malformed JSON, mount Home, and compare bytes after effects; inspect source fallback/save path. This failure mode is source-confirmed, not a real-user experiment.
user_impact: Opening a feature can overwrite recoverable raw bytes after parse failure; wrong-shaped valid JSON can instead crash.
proposed_solution: Validate without replacing source bytes; suppress autosave after failed initialization, present recovery/export of raw data. Audit each writer independently.
tests_required: Malformed JSON, null and wrong shapes; reload; raw bytes preserved; quota denial; recovery UI.

title: Food saves report success after storage quota failure
evidence: Synthetic setItem throws QuotaExceededError: addCustomFood returns success:true but stored foods remain []; evidence/synthetic-food-quota.json. Save helper swallows the exception.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: New or edited foods can appear saved although they are lost on reload.
proposed_solution: Propagate failed writes to callers and visible error state; retain form contents. No key or schema changes.
tests_required: Create/edit/delete/restore food with throwing storage; unchanged original bytes and failed response.

title: Independent hook snapshots can overwrite newer whole-store state
evidence: Whole workout document autosaved from hook-local React state; no shared store or storage-event subscription. Calendar mounts useWorkouts and RecentActivityWidget mounts another instance. Across tabs each edits a stale snapshot.
reproduction: Open two disposable tabs before any edits; create a workout in each in turn and inspect the shared document. The stale-write path is confirmed by source; an automated concurrent UI reproduction remains to add.
user_impact: Concurrent edits can lose workouts, routines, logs or journal updates.
proposed_solution: First characterize two writers, then centralize one writer/subscription with stale revision protection; retain serialized formats.
tests_required: Two tabs, two mounted consumers, rapid edits, restore while open, closed/reopened instance.

title: Available-widget selector sorts React state in place
evidence: Synthetic render observes widget state order changing from later,first to first,later merely by reading selector. Enabled selector already filters before sorting.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Hidden mutation can affect render ordering and default/reset array reuse. Current Home does not mount the configurable renderer.
proposed_solution: Sort a shallow array copy; preserve the position comparator and ties. This is the only application correction in batch A.
tests_required: Unsorted input, stable equal positions, repeated reads, enabled visibility, untouched stored bytes.

title: Inclusive calendar-day count overcounts fall DST
evidence: America/New_York: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-02 returns 3 rather than 2 because 25 hours are rounded up. Workout day denominators separately floor elapsed days at use-workouts.ts:641 and :758.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: All-time averages and consistency denominators can be wrong across DST.
proposed_solution: Separate calculation PR: compare calendar date indices, retain local-day interpretation and historical formats.
tests_required: US/Europe/Australia transitions, leap/year boundaries, same day, reverse/invalid ranges.

title: Paused workout cannot reliably resume after reload
evidence: Persisted isPaused survives but pauseStartTime is memory-only and resume early-returns when it is null. stopSession also subtracts accumulated pausedTime, excluding an ongoing pause.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Paused sessions can become stuck or duration can include pause time.
proposed_solution: Define a backwards-compatible pause recovery policy with explicit fixtures before changing persisted semantics.
tests_required: Pause, reload, resume, stop while paused, suspension, midnight, old currentSession shapes.

title: Sequential goal writes overwrite one another
evidence: Fasting saves fastingHours then maxFastingHours; updateGoal spreads closed-over goals for each. Browser probe saving 18/26 leaves unified fastingHours=16, max=26, legacy fasting=18.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Different screens display different fasting targets after a save.
proposed_solution: Use an atomic multi-goal operation or functional state update with coherent persistence; preserve legacy synchronization.
tests_required: Save two fields, reopen/reload, legacy and unified values, other goal edits.

title: Unstable goal callback resets typed input
evidence: Effect depends on newly created getDailyGoal; typing triggers rerender and effect resets input. Browser probe fills 35 and reads 20.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Cannot reliably enter a different meditation goal.
proposed_solution: Stable callback or initialize draft only when opening/saved goal changes; retain draft on unrelated renders.
tests_required: Type multi-digit goal, focus/blur, open/close, save/reload, unrelated render.

title: Calculator ignores current Profile age
evidence: Calculator reads fitcircle_profile.age, while Profile writes fitcircle_age at profile.tsx:35–37. Calculator defaults to age 25.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: BMR/calorie targets can use the wrong age; formulas themselves need not change.
proposed_solution: Read current key with documented legacy fallback and subscribe to appropriate changes.
tests_required: Age 37 vs fallback25, legacy profile, missing/invalid age, measurement input, unchanged BMR formula.

title: Per-100g derivation assumes all quantities are grams
evidence: Uses 100 / input.quantity regardless of unit; cup, ounce, piece and serving have no mass conversion. Historical generator also scales quantities without a density model.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Derived nutrition metadata can be misleading. Active meal calculations mainly use base serving values; not every displayed total is proven wrong.
proposed_solution: Define serving/mass semantics with reference fixtures; preserve existing foods until reviewed.
tests_required: g/oz/cup/piece/serving/ml fixtures and round-trip legacy foods.

title: Food edits can retain stale derived nutrition
evidence: Recomputes nutritionPer100g only for truthy input.quantity different from 100; returning a previously 50g food to 100g retains old derived values.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Stored base and derived values disagree; consumers of derived values can disagree.
proposed_solution: Recompute or explicitly remove stale derivation according to validated unit semantics.
tests_required: 50g→100g; macro-only edits; no-quantity edits; restore compatibility.

title: Historical edits write an additional food key for today
evidence: Additional fitcircle_food_tracker + getTodayString writer uses today, while primary effect writes selectedDate; analogous edit writer later in handler.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Legacy dated key may contain a copy of a different day; backups preserve that ambiguity.
proposed_solution: Separate compatibility PR: characterize both dated formats and date-switch effects before correcting writer date.
tests_required: Yesterday/today additions and edits, midnight, both key formats, backup round trips.

title: Recent-food enumeration includes the food catalog
evidence: Broad fitcircle_food_ prefix matches fitcircle_food_database, which is an array. Each change reparses catalog/history.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Recent list can include never-logged catalog foods and unnecessary synchronous work.
proposed_solution: Match dated-food registry patterns; characterize ordering/unique-entry rules.
tests_required: Catalog-only origin, both dated patterns, malformed metadata, measured search/history performance.

title: Invalid date route crashes the view
evidence: Browser /dynamic-overview/not-a-date raises Invalid time value and removes main; safe startup recovery offers reload rather than rendering an invalid-date page.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Invalid deep links interrupt use and reload repeats the invalid route.
proposed_solution: Validate route parameters and offer a safe navigation fallback; add scoped error boundary later.
tests_required: Malformed dates, impossible dates, leap day, Pages 404 recovery, valid historical views.

title: Toast notifications are never rendered by the app
evidence: useToast is used by food flows; shared toast module exports primitives, but no mounted provider/viewport or mapped toast renderer appears in App/main/pages.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Food operation success/failure messages may be invisible.
proposed_solution: Mount a single accessible renderer with existing UI tokens; verify errors remain visible independently of toast expiry.
tests_required: Create/edit failure, quota, dismissal, keyboard/screen reader, overlay stacking.

title: Recovery fallback ignores modern object log entries
evidence: Compares dayLog[id] > 0 and count < goal directly when entries are objects. Explicit zero completed days also falls through because of truthiness.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Workout totals/recovery percentage can be wrong in fallback consumers.
proposed_solution: Reuse historical count/goal interpretation while distinguishing undefined from zero.
tests_required: Numeric and object logs; explicit 0; deleted workouts; authoritative historical goals.

title: Saved tile orders omit newly added features
evidence: Saved IDs map to defaults and filter unknown IDs without appending missing defaults.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: An older partial saved layout can leave supported tiles inaccessible through Logs.
proposed_solution: Define compatible completion of saved order, retaining user ordering; do not blindly reset layouts.
tests_required: Partial/empty/unknown layouts, duplicates, all current IDs, restore/reload.

title: Goals and Recent Activity renderer cases remain placeholders
evidence: Concrete components exist but renderer returns text. Renderer/settings are outside current main entry graph; RecentActivityWidget itself is actively used by Calendar.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Dormant customization cannot be promoted as complete; deleting components would discard intended capability.
proposed_solution: Retain all implementations; decide integration only after goal-schema and parity fixtures.
tests_required: Mount each type; ensure Calendar recent activity stays functional; compare goal algorithms.

title: Interactive calendar cells lack keyboard semantics
evidence: Calendar day actions are clickable divs; sidebar profile/Settings also use click-only divs in multiple pages.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Keyboard users cannot reliably activate these controls.
proposed_solution: Use semantic buttons with accessible names and current visual styles in an isolated accessibility PR.
tests_required: Tab/Enter/Space, focus outline, screen-reader labels, existing touch interactions.

title: Reminder icon controls and hover menu need accessible names and touch review
evidence: Several action buttons rely on icon/hover presentation. Existing E2E selects some by button index, evidencing missing stable accessible identity.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Discoverability and assistive interaction are weak.
proposed_solution: Explicit names/states and touch-visible menu affordance without changing design.
tests_required: Accessible-role queries, touch menu, keyboard completion/reordering/deletion.

title: Countdown relies on interval callbacks rather than elapsed time
evidence: Meditation subtracts one second per callback; use-timer.ts has equivalent callback counting. Browser suspension throttles timers; active meditation timer is not persisted.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Displayed elapsed/remaining time may drift after backgrounding; navigation can discard the active countdown.
proposed_solution: Define intended background behavior; wall-clock timing and lifecycle handling in a timer-only PR.
tests_required: Suspended/late callbacks, route navigation, pause/resume, physical iOS audio/backgrounding.

title: Audio contexts are created without explicit close
evidence: Start/audio gong paths construct AudioContext; no corresponding close found.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Repeated sessions may retain browser audio resources.
proposed_solution: Reuse a controlled context and close/dispose on lifecycle boundaries after audio behavior testing.
tests_required: Repeated sessions, denied autoplay, suspension, route unmount, actual iOS audio.

title: Known dependency advisories require scoped triage
evidence: npm audit reports 37 affected package nodes (21 high/13 moderate/3 low), no critical. --omit=dev reports24 nodes: includes CSS build tooling pulled via production-listed tailwindcss-animate. These are not 37 demonstrated exploits.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Toolchain input exposure and transitive lodash advisory exposure require updates with compatibility evidence.
proposed_solution: Upgrade related chains separately; distinguish shipped JS from production-install classification.
tests_required: Lockfile diff, check/unit/build/E2E, bundle inspection, development-server network exposure.

title: README references an absent license file
evidence: README states MIT and see LICENSE; package says MIT but no LICENSE is tracked.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Contributors cannot find the referenced license text.
proposed_solution: Maintainer confirms copyright/license text and adds the intended file.
tests_required: README link check and repository license detection.

title: Semantic color tokens are raw HSL channels
evidence: Several configured colors use var(--token) while index.css variables are HSL channel triples, requiring hsl(...) to be CSS colors. Many active screens use explicit slate/colors, so extent needs computed-style checks.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Some default semantic component colors may fail to resolve.
proposed_solution: Isolated token correction only after computed-style coverage and screenshot review.
tests_required: Default/primary/destructive/foreground computed colors, disabled states, dark mode.

title: Built search index is not consumed by searchProducts
evidence: Index built at initialization/each mutation; searchProducts rereads whole JSON then filters/sorts directly (lines 226–285).
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: Extra allocation and repeated parsing; catalog currently465 records, historical backup29766.
proposed_solution: Measure before optimizing; use/rebuild one coherent index or remove only after tests establish equivalent search ranking.
tests_required: Cold/warm query timings, prefix/ranking, custom edits/deletions, large synthetic catalog.

title: Food input validation permits invalid serving/nutrition values
evidence: Service checks required fields/NaN but does not enforce finite positive serving quantity for all inputs. UI numeric parsing also permits some negative values. Backup food validator requires positive quantity.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: A record accepted by editing may later block a complete backup.
proposed_solution: Align feature validation with existing backup constraints, retain invalid original bytes for correction.
tests_required: Negative/zero quantity, Infinity/NaN, negative macros, blank optional nutrients, export after create.

title: Restore rollback has a residual failure boundary
evidence: Rollback uses browser storage and a journal; if both target writes and rollback writes fail permanently, recovery remains pending. Tests cover controlled quota/interruption but browser storage is not a transactional database.
reproduction: Use the isolated synthetic fixture described in the evidence; never run against an installed user profile.
user_impact: A device-level persistent storage failure can prevent immediate recovery; cannot promise absolute atomicity under browser eviction/crash.
proposed_solution: Retain existing journal and fail-closed recovery; add persistent denial tests and explicit recovery guidance before any persistence redesign.
tests_required: Persistent denied storage, repeated startup recovery, failed journal write, partial rollback, physical termination.

title: Backup import has no size or resource bound
evidence: FileReader.readAsText reads the selected file in full, then synchronous JSON.parse and structural validation run with no file.size/depth preflight limit.
reproduction: In an isolated profile choose a very large synthetic JSON file; measure responsiveness without applying the plan. Not executed with a device-scale oversized file in this audit.
user_impact: Accidental large files can consume memory or freeze the UI before an error; this is local file input, not a demonstrated remote exploit.
proposed_solution: Add a documented reasonable byte limit and safe validation resource strategy without excluding realistic complete/legacy food backups.
tests_required: Large valid legacy/current backup fixtures, oversized rejection before read/write, malformed deep nesting, visible failure with original storage unchanged.
